poc_plan: POC objective: validate Dedicated pool with Canary + Fallback routing and verify latency, cost, and rollback behavior. Scope: 7-day canary, followed by 7-day ramp to 50% traffic, then decision. Canary config: start at 5% traffic to Dedicated cluster (single-region), health checks and SLOs monitored in Redwood Console. Metrics: p95 latency, error rate, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens. Canary thresholds: if p95 > 250ms or error rate > 1% for two consecutive 10-min windows -> automatic cutover to Hosted fallback; SE to investigate. Model variants: baseline = open Llama-3-13B quantized (customer-preferred), fallback = smaller quantized 7B hosted model (lower cost) for overflow. Region failover: primary us-east-1 Dedicated pool, failover to us-west-2 Hosted pool (region-policy) with geo-aware routing. Rollback: automated rollback on Canary failure (traffic re-routed to hosted variant, rollback incident documented in Console, SE to run A/B quality checks). Success criteria: p95 <= 200ms and <0.5% errors and quality regression <2% on benchmark prompts. Deliverables: runbook, canary dashboard, SOW, post-POC report (latency, cost, quality), decision doc.
